notes.title: Hotfix .350
notes.content:
- Fixed issue where Bullseye + LockShot bullets would stay alive indefinitely.
- Fixed issue where Voids Hooks woudn't stun enemies.
- Improved performance of homing (Bullseye).

notes.title: Madshot: Road to Madness is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161609/d808cc51da1b9d06f69fdf9232f1ad90d48d901e.png[/img]

Beware humans, 

the Abyss gates are now open for anyone brave enough to embrace their own [b]Road to Madness[/b]!
 
[previewyoutube=fWVMyKC-Ry0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]ABOUT MADSHOT: ROAD TO MADNESS[/h2] 

Exterminate [b]infinite hordes[/b] of nightmarish abominations in a stylish ballet of weapons, abilities and endless combinations. 

Combine, upgrade, and survive as long as possible with your acrobatic fighting skills to reach the very top of the Leaderboard. [b]Conquer what it takes to be the best, or kneel before the Madness[/b]. 

[h2]SPECIAL OFFER[/h2] 

[b]Madshot: Road to Madness[/b] is available now as a standalone game experience for $2.99/€2.99/£2.69 but, remember,  you can access it for [b]FREE[/b] if you already own the original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524550/Madshot/]Madshot[/url] game.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149610/Madshot_Road_to_Madness/
And now, let the slaughter... [b]BEGIN[/b]! 

[i]If you want to find out more about Madshot: Road to Madness, stay up to date and let us know your feedback, remember to join the conversation on [url=https://twitter.com/MadshotTheGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/y7pS6W7Z8f]Discord[/url]! [/i]

HOOK Team

notes.title: Play the demo @ Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161609/d808cc51da1b9d06f69fdf9232f1ad90d48d901e.png[/img]

Humans, are you ready for a mad, back-flipping ride into a too-crowded abyss? [b]Madshot: Road to Madness[/b] will participate in the upcoming[b] Steam Next Fest[/b] with a [b]demo[/b], already [b]available on Steam[/b]!

[i]In Madshot: Road to Madness, you'll face off against horrific monsters and survive multi-phased boss battles on an ever-changing road. Equip endless upgrade combinations and use your acrobatic fighting skills to fight through a procedurally generated world full of hideous opponents, where every playthrough throws out new challenges in an ever-changing gameplay experience.[/i]

[previewyoutube=XLdPqMKOq68;full][/previewyoutube]
In the [i]Madshot: Road to Madness[/i] demo you will experience acrobatic rogue-like shooting action with [b]unlockable weapons[/b], [b]ultimate abilities[/b], and [b]sidearms [/b]with around [b]150 upgrades[/b] at your disposal as you battle through [b]endless hordes of hideous enemies[/b]. 

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ta64VUv6gx]Discord [/url]to share your feedback and opinion and remember, if you're already playing Madshot you'll be granted access to Road to Madness for free when it's launched!

See you in the abyss
